field.label: Enabled
field.help: Include this interface in the bridge.

field.label: Interface
field.help: mDNS is received on and forwarded to every enabled interface. Avoid WAN and other untrusted interfaces.

field.label: Disable IPv4
field.help: Do not forward mDNS over IPv4 on this interface. Has no effect if IPv4 is already disabled globally.

field.label: Disable IPv6
field.help: Do not forward mDNS over IPv6 on this interface. Has no effect if IPv6 is already disabled globally.

field.label: Inbound mode
field.help: Applied to packets received on this interface, after the global filter. Controls what devices on this network can advertise to the others.

field.label: Inbound custom filters
field.help: See the help on the General tab for the filter format. In a deny list, the single entry <all> blocks every service received on this interface.

field.label: Outbound mode
field.help: Applied to packets before they are sent on this interface, from any other interface. Controls what devices on this network can see. A peer rule for a specific source interface replaces this filter for packets from that source.

field.label: Outbound custom filters
field.help: In a deny list, the single entry <all> sends nothing to this interface unless a peer rule allows it.
